problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must plan a tour for a maintenance crew to service eight distinct facilities.

The travel durations between facilities are recorded in minutes:
* Facility Alpha to Bravo: 141.5 minutes
* Alpha to Charlie: 95.5 minutes
* Alpha to Delta: 63.2 minutes
* Alpha to Echo: 121.0 minutes
* Alpha to Foxtrot: 170.4 minutes
* Alpha to Golf: 84.6 minutes
* Alpha to Hotel: 109.1 minutes
* Bravo to Charlie: 100.4 minutes
* Bravo to Delta: 82.8 minutes
* Bravo to Echo: 21.8 minutes
* Bravo to Foxtrot: 36.2 minutes
* Bravo to Golf: 107.5 minutes
* Bravo to Hotel: 67.9 minutes
* Charlie to Delta: 50.2 minutes
* Charlie to Echo: 92.0 minutes
* Charlie to Foxtrot: 110.5 minutes
* Charlie to Golf: 12.6 minutes
* Charlie to Hotel: 122.2 minutes
* Delta to Echo: 65.2 minutes
* Delta to Foxtrot: 108.2 minutes
* Delta to Golf: 46.5 minutes
* Delta to Hotel: 77.6 minutes
* Echo to Foxtrot: 57.0 minutes
* Echo to Golf: 96.9 minutes
* Echo to Hotel: 50.1 minutes
* Foxtrot to Golf: 120.4 minutes
* Foxtrot to Hotel: 103.9 minutes
* Golf to Hotel: 122.3 minutes

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient circuit that allows the crew to perform a service call at each facility precisely once before concluding back at the initial facility.
